general.title: Settings
general.description: Workspaces, AI budget, limits and agent connection.

workspaces.title: Workspaces
workspaces.deleteDescription: All its data, workflows and interfaces will be permanently erased. This cannot be undone.
workspaces.limit: Your account is limited to {max, plural, one {# workspace} other {# workspaces}}. Contact your administrator to raise it.
workspaces.limitUpgrade: Your plan includes {max, plural, one {# workspace} other {# workspaces}}.
workspaces.description: Names of the organization's workspaces. Visible to all members.

budget.title: Monthly AI budget
budget.description: Monthly spending cap for AI blocks. Beyond it, they are paused.

limits.title: Workspace limits
limits.description: Beyond these, additions are rejected with a clear message. Empty field: default value.
limits.concurrency: Workflow steps running at the same time

mcp.title: Connect your AI
mcp.description: Give your AI (ChatGPT, Claude, Gemini, Cursor…) access to your data, workflows, functions and pages.

danger.title: Danger zone
danger.description: Irreversible actions. Only an administrator can perform them.
danger.deleteHint: Workflows, tables, runs and credentials will be permanently deleted.

roleHints.admin: Manages everything: members, API keys, settings
roleHints.member: Creates and edits data, workflows and pages
roleHints.end_user: Only opens the pages meant for them

members.title: Members
members.description: Who can access the organization, and what each person can do.
members.removeDescription: This person will lose access to the organization immediately. You can invite them again.
members.inviteHint: The person receives an email and gets access to the chosen workspaces once they accept the invitation.
members.adminAllWorkspaces: Owners and admins access every workspace of the organization.
members.editWorkspacesHint: This person can only see and open the workspaces checked here.
members.rolesHint: What each role can do in the workspaces it accesses.

secrets.title: Credentials
secrets.description: Keys for your tools (OpenAI, HubSpot, Stripe…), encrypted, never visible to your AI.
secrets.newDescription: The value is encrypted and will never be shown again. An existing name is replaced.
secrets.editDescription: Enter the new value. It is encrypted and replaces the current one, which cannot be shown.
secrets.emptyDescription: Add an API key or a token for the tools your workflows use.
secrets.deleteDescription: Workflows and functions that use it will fail until it is recreated. The value cannot be recovered.
secrets.note: Your AI uses a credential by its name, never by its value. Every change is recorded in the audit log.
secrets.deleteUsed: This credential is used by {list}. They will fail until a credential with this name is recreated. The value cannot be recovered.

connections.title: Connections
connections.description: Accounts your workflows act as (Google…). You sign in once, Runbase keeps the access valid.
connections.connectDescription: You will be sent to {provider} to approve access, then brought back here.
connections.nameHint: Optional. Give each account its own name if you connect several (work, sales…).
connections.disconnectDescription: Workflows that use this account will fail until it is connected again. Access is revoked at the provider.
connections.noProvidersDescription: Installed connectors do not use any sign-in service yet.
connections.note: Your AI uses a connection by its name, never sees the access. Every change is recorded in the audit log.

apiKeys.title: API keys
apiKeys.description: Keys let your tools call the Runbase API. They are shown only once, at creation.
apiKeys.newDescription: For your AI, scripts and external integrations.
apiKeys.copyWarning: Copy this key: it won't be shown again.
apiKeys.objectsHint: No box checked: all tables. Otherwise, the key only sees the checked tables and their records.
apiKeys.toolsHint: Empty: all tools. Otherwise, comma-separated names.
apiKeys.revokeDescription: Agents and scripts using it will lose access immediately. A revoked key cannot be reactivated.
apiKeys.emptyDescription: Create a key to connect your AI, a script or the API.
apiKeys.note: Your AI agent never has access to keys in clear text. Revoke any key you no longer use.

audit.title: Audit log
audit.description: Every action by people and agents, with the details of the change.
audit.emptyDescription: Creations, edits and deletions, made in the interface or by an agent, are recorded here automatically.

admin.title: Agent feedback
admin.description: Bugs, limits and ideas reported by AI agents, across all accounts.
admin.emptyDescription: Agents report the bugs and limits they hit here.

page.title: Settings
page.description: Manage the workspace, its members and its access.

plan.title: Plan
plan.description: Your current plan, provided by your hosting operator.

quota.ask: Plan limit reached. Ask an owner or admin to upgrade the plan.

plans.title: Plans
plans.description: Pick the plan that fits your team. You confirm and pay on the next page.

usage.title: Usage
usage.description: What this account uses against its effective limits. No limit means unlimited.
